visual_description: A square wooden sifting tray with ergonomic side handles. The center is a fine silver metal mesh. The frame is made of weathered oak with visible grain and dried mud splatters from the Hell Creek formation. It is shown from a high-angle studio perspective to emphasize the mesh density.

constraints.logic: Used to process 'spoils' from the excavation pit to ensure no small teeth or micro-fossils are lost.
